description: This file defines Korean localization strings and functions for a chat application, including UI labels, error messages, memory prompts, and configuration text. It exports a partial locale object used for translating the interface into Korean.

methods.name: Error.Unauthorized
methods.description: Message indicating lack of permission with a link to settings.

methods.name: ChatItem.ChatItemCount
methods.description: Function returning Korean string for message count.

methods.name: Chat.SubTitle
methods.description: Function generating subtitle with message count.

methods.name: Chat.Actions
methods.description: Contains labels for chat actions like move to list, export, copy, stop, retry, delete.

methods.name: Chat.Input
methods.description: Function returning input hint string based on submit key, adding instructions for prompt search.

methods.name: Update.FoundUpdate
methods.description: Function indicating a new version has been found.

methods.name: Usage.SubTitle
methods.description: Generates subtitle indicating current month usage and subscription amount.

methods.name: Store.Prompt.History
methods.description: Creates summary prompt for conversation history.

methods.name: Store.Prompt.Topic
methods.description: Creates prompt to generate a concise title for conversation.

methods.name: Store.Prompt.Summarize
methods.description: Creates a prompt to summarize discussion in under 200 words.

methods.name: Copy.Success
methods.description: Message indicating successful copy to clipboard.

methods.name: Copy.Failed
methods.description: Message indicating failure to copy to clipboard.

methods.name: Context.Toast
methods.description: Displays count of context prompts used.
